This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds. BINNER: raised from the template default 20ns
(50MHz) to 50ns (20MHz): the first real harden closed timing cleanly at tt/ff
but had real setup violations at the ss corner (WNS to -2.85ns) at 50MHz
signoff. The control-plane logic (SPI, register file, measurement FSM) does
not need 50MHz; ring/Fmax measurement bandwidth is unaffected (rings run in
their own clock domain; Fmax capture flops are false-pathed in binner.sdc).
See DECISIONS.md D-CLOCK-PERIOD.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
BINNER: never buffer or resize ring-oscillator, delay-chain or Fmax capture cells/nets.
Every such instance and net name contains 'notouch_' (src/binner_cells.vh).
tools/netlist_audit.py verifies the result on the post-route netlist. See DECISIONS.md D-DONTTOUCH.
BINNER: base.sdc plus false paths into the Fmax capture flops. See DECISIONS.md D-SDC.
BINNER: author-name silicon art, a one-pin Metal4 macro from tools/make_art.py. It is
the ~19 fF wire load of the art ring (source 21); its .lib gives STA that load. See D-ART-RO.
Placed in the Metal4 PDN stripe gap x 218.13-252.10 um (clearance 0.83/0.66 um), where
the art ring settled in 092e95b, with pin A at the bottom-right facing the ring bank,
to shorten the routed feed (253 um there). See DECISIONS.md D-ART-RO.
No row-cut or PDN halo around the art. With the default 10 um FP_MACRO_*_HALO, CutRows
ended the rows left of the art at x~14.6 um, short of the first stripe pair (19.68/
22.98 um); their Metal1 rails were unconnected, PDN channel repair added Metal4 straps
at x~7.6/10.9 um, and those became extra VPWR/VGND pins that fail the TT pin check.
The art has no power pins and already clears the stripes by >= 0.63 um.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
